suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify in the backend-worker skill that 'write failing tests first (RED)' applies to implementation features. For test-only features (writing tests for already-existing code), the tests ARE the implementation and strict RED-GREEN-REFACTOR doesn't map cleanly — creating a full test file in a single pass is acceptable.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature sprint-cross-area-config-handoff-alignment worker created the full test file in one pass rather than strict RED-GREEN. The deviation is pragmatic: the code under test already exists, so the 'RED' phase (writing a test that fails because the code doesn't exist yet) doesn't apply.

nonBlockingIssues.description: AGENTS.md config table shows '—' for sprint.worker_can_escalate and sprint.escalate_on_stuck env vars, but the overrides now exist. (Captured in suggestedGuidanceUpdates.)
VAL-CROSS-001 test 3 verifies config propagation indirectly through createStageLoop factory wrapper's phasesTotal cap. Functional but indirect.
VAL-CROSS-002 test 2 implicitly couples assertion string to helper default ('Add a hello world endpoint') rather than explicitly setting taskDescription.
OpenTUI adapter test creates 20+ no-op stubs for UIActions inline. Could be extracted to createMockUIActions() helper in sprint-test-helpers.ts for maintainability.
Escalation test relies on real readHandoff failing (file not found) rather than explicit DI mock for controlled failure. Functionally correct but slightly brittle.
